_comment: Copy this file to config/local.json and fill in real values. config/local.json is gitignored — the real identifiers never ship.
_comment_ical: On modern macOS, Calendar.app no longer keeps readable .ics files under ~/Library/Calendars. Export each calendar from Calendar.app (File > Export > Export...) into a dedicated directory and point at that directory here. Re-export when you want a fresh snapshot.
_comment_local_files: Directories that hold .txt, .md, .rtf, .docx, or .pdf documents you want sanitized. The adapter walks these recursively and dispatches per extension. Legacy .doc halts — convert to .docx or .pdf first.
_comment_imessage: Path to the real chat.db. On macOS it's ~/Library/Messages/chat.db. Terminal needs Full Disk Access. The adapter copies this to raw-staging/imessage/snapshot.db at run start and never writes to the source.
